children: There's speculation fund traders are pulling out of long positions in corn, says Charlie Sernatinger of Marex in a note. "[Corn is] down anticipating a weekend harvest prehedge tonight, more chart selling, and talk that macro funds are exiting commodities anticipating a U.S. recession," says Sernatinger. Last week's Commitments of Traders report from the CFTC showed a sizable decrease in long corn positions, with nearly 55,000 long contracts shown being closed. The CFTC will be updating its report this afternoon, although the data is a few days behind. CBOT corn is down 0.9% to $4.86 a bushel. (kirk.maltais@wsj.com)
